prompt: You sent the open link. A later download is from an address not on the job.

choices.label: That has to be the client.
An open link cannot tell you who.
It expired when you closed the lid.

prompt: A personal mailbox got the drawings. That mailbox forwarded them.

choices.label: Only you can forward your mail.
You do not control the next forward.
A personal box is still work.

prompt: The count, not the names, is on a slide. Someone outside the meeting quotes it.

choices.label: A count is not the list.
The number still left the room.
Quoting it means they were allowed.

prompt: The sheet says internal. The meeting is also internal.

choices.label: The mark says who may see the rows.
A slide is not a copy.

prompt: You closed the writing tab. The complaint is still in the tool.

choices.label: It is fine if the number was removed.

prompt: The name is gone. The paragraph still describes one account.

choices.label: No name means it is safe to paste.
One account can still be recognized.
A tool that says private is enough.
